quote.text: There is no worse penalty for vice than the fact that it is dissatisfied with itself and all its fellows.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that a life led by vice breeds constant inner dissatisfaction; as a parent, guide your children to see that true fulfillment comes from integrity rather than the fleeting allure of vice.
    • Demonstrate through everyday actions that self-respect and compassion toward oneself and others are more rewarding than the endless discord that accompanies vice.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that when vice governs decisions, it not only undermines personal integrity but also destabilizes trust within your team; leadership calls for the courage to choose virtue over comfort.
    • Cultivate an environment where honesty and ethical choices are paramount, knowing that true leadership is about inspiring steadiness and satisfaction in both oneself and the collective.
  • Product Management
    • In the realm of product management, recognize that shortcuts or unethical choices (forms of vice) can lead to persistent dissatisfaction among stakeholders, ultimately harming the product's integrity.
    • Strive to make decisions rooted in long-term value and moral clarity; this discipline not only improves the product but also fosters trust and shared satisfaction across the team.
